none: PAS CAM-6052ED: Roman Coin : Incomplete copper-alloy radiate coin of Tetricus II, AD 272-274
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ S[PES AVGG] ; D/ [C PIVESV TETRICVS CAES]

An incomplete copper-alloy radiate coin of Tetricus II, AD 272-274 (Reece period 13). Reverse legend reads S[PES AVGG]. Reverse shows Spes walking left, holding flowers (one leg is visible). Mint is Gaul II, AD 272-274. See Cunetio cf. p.153, no.2647. Obverse legend reads [C PIVESV TETRICVS CAES]. Obverse shows a radiate, draped bust right, seen from rear. Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 0.79g,…
